meta.reference: CoC-early pacing; economy redefined to Cash/Oil/Power + Navy/Army/Air per owner spec
meta.curve: Explicit per-level tables. Times are seconds; production is per hour.
meta.note: Explicit tables. Three training buildings independently gate troop tiers. RSS and troop counts use x1,000 display denominations; Might splits permanent infrastructure from troop power.

combat.woundedNote: 70% of casualties wounded (hospital, healable, capped); 30% dead
combat.counterNote: X beats Y: air>army, army>navy, navy>air. Winner arm gets +counterBonusAtk attack vs the arm it beats.

might.note: Total Might = permanent Infrastructure Might + fielded Troop Might. Building rows store cumulative power. Troop power can later fall through losses; buildings never do.
might.targetAtMatureCity: At roughly 60% of max troop capacity: 20-30% infrastructure, 70-80% troops before hero/research/gear systems exist.
might.buildingSeedFormula: buildingWeight × level^4 × 60, baked into explicit per-level rows; tune rows directly after this seed.

offline.note: producers bank up to 12h then sit full until collected; storage cap also applies

shield.note: sys.shield — new keeps protected until Townhall L10, OR until the player attacks (shield drops). Extra shields purchasable.

display.note: Presentation denomination only: 1 internal resource/troop batch is shown as 1,000 units. Economy timing and queue math remain unchanged.

building.keep.role: Gates everything, unlocks buildings. Shield lifts at L10. Progression to L30.

building.armyCamp.role: Trains Army units. Its level unlocks Army tiers and raises Army capacity and training throughput.

building.navalBase.role: Trains Navy units. Its level unlocks Navy tiers and raises Navy capacity and training throughput.

building.airfield.role: Trains Air units. Its level unlocks Air tiers and raises Air capacity and training throughput.

building.embassy.role: Receives allied reinforcement troops (capacity). Reinforcement mechanic = Phase 2.

building.academy.role: Research Institute: Troops / Economy(RSS) / Development(storage cap, troop count, build speed…). Research nodes = Phase 2.

building.watchtower.role: Issues solo (PvE) tasks/quests. Task content = later.

building.milestone.role: Monument — shows server-wide progress and triggers server-wide rewards. Display/meta, not a resource-upgrade building. Backend-driven, later.

townhallPrerequisites.note: To upgrade Townhall to level L, every listed building must be at >= L-1. FIXED & known (not random), so players can plan. Warehouse is the anchor from L3+. Count escalates 2/3/4. Specialized training buildings are elective branches and are intentionally not Townhall prerequisites.

designTargets.note: Calibration targets for the explicit level tables and local pacing simulator.
designTargets.newbieToKeep10Days: 2-3 (Townhall L1->L10 is the newbie funnel; guided, deterministic)
designTargets.f2pToKeep30Days: 120-150 (~4-5 months, no speedups, 2 build slots, driven by TH + prerequisites + resource waits)

curves.buildingCosts: piecewise benchmark seed: x1.50 through L10, x1.40 after L10; tune individual rows
curves.buildingTimes: explicit by building family; Townhall is the long pole
curves.production: piecewise benchmark seed: x1.30 through L10, x1.22 after L10

calibration.note: Early producer output is intentionally generous while outside-city faucets are absent. Rebalance producer output downward when those faucets ship. Initial explicit-table calibration: 4.5x the old placeholder production; post-L10 build times: 0.5x the first bake.

might.earlyGame: Infrastructure dominates while troop queues are still filling.
might.matureNoHeroSystems: At ~60% troop-cap fill, target ~25% infrastructure / ~75% troop Might.
might.warning: Might is a progression/status score, not the combat formula. Combat uses attack/defense, counters, march composition and later buffs.

world.note: Concentric world: ring 10 = outer edge (newbie spawn), ring 1 = center (the Circle). Node/monster level ~ (11-ring). Inner rings open via server progression (stub now).

gatherNodes.note: Leveled outdoor resource nodes 1-10. A node yields ONE resource (assigned per instance). carry = sum(troop.load) + hero carry. Haul/trip = min(carry, node remaining). Trip time = carry / (gatherRatePerHour * academySpeedMult). Difficulty is intentionally high so Academy gather-speed research is the main lever. Node depletes by totalSupply.
